overview.mechanism: Icodextrin is a glucose polymer used as an osmotic agent for sustained ultrafiltration during the long peritoneal dialysis dwell.
uses: Peritoneal dialysis according to an individualized dialysis prescription; solution is for intraperitoneal use, not intravenous infusion.

paragraphs.text: The reference US label describes intraperitoneal administration, aseptic technique, and monitoring of fluid balance, electrolytes and acid–base status. A generic registry title does not define an exchange volume, dwell time or daily number of exchanges.

Icodextrin metabolites can interfere with certain glucose meters and test strips, producing falsely high readings and potentially dangerous insulin administration. Use only a glucose-specific compatible method during treatment and for the post-treatment period specified in the product label.
The reference product is intended for the long dwell; it is not a direct substitute for every dextrose exchange. The approved product insert defines use, contraindications and compatibility.
